title: “Producing visuals in-house saves time, budget control and reactivity”
metaTitle: Production of e-commerce visuals in-house: time savings and controlled budget | PackshotCreator
description: Discover how the production of e-commerce visuals in-house is revolutionizing your digital strategy. Grégory Beyrouti (WiziShop) shares his expertise to save time, control your budget and increase your conversions.
author: Laurent Wainberg
content:
In a world where visuals dominate e-commerce, the ability to produce quality images in-house has become a major competitive advantage. Gregory Beyrouti, co-founder and CEO of WiziShop, shares her expertise on the importance of visuals in online commerce.

Benefits of producing visuals in-house

Producing visuals in-house offers several key advantages:

  • Time saver : Reduce production times by controlling the process.
  • Control of the budget : Avoid external costs by producing your own visuals.
  • Increased responsiveness : Respond quickly to the visual needs of your business.

The latest visual trends in e-commerce

In the age of social networks, Inspiration is at the heart of any visual strategy. 3D visuals are a major innovation, although reserved for certain sectors. To inspire Internet users, it is crucial to present your products with attractive images.

Impact of quality visuals on an e-commerce site

Quality visuals reinforce the customer trust in the merchant. In the high-tech or household appliance sectors, detailed images allow customers to understand the complex functionalities of products. A non-qualitative image can leave a feeling of amateurism, making conversion more difficult.

Tips for beginning online retailers

To produce your own visuals, get trained in photography and invest in a good camera and a mini photo studio. Choose two types of visuals:

  • The product on white background to highlight its details
  • The product put in a situation so that the customer can project himself

Interview with Grégory Beyrouti

You give daily advice to e-retailers. How did this idea come about?

Today I want sharing my expertise and my experience with the largest number. With my daily advice, sent by email, I am talking about e-commerce, but also about SEO, Webmarketing, Growth Hacking, Copywriting, Entrepreneurship... In addition to the WiziShop e-commerce blog and all the levers already in place to communicate with e-retailers, I now want to offer a new discussion channel to offer even more proximity to my customers and our community. With e-commerce advice sent every morning, beyond the wealth of information and advice provided, it is easier for e-retailers to react and discuss with me by simply returning an email.

What are the latest visual trends in e-commerce?

‍

‍

More than ever, inspiration is at the heart of a visual strategy. In the era of social networks Instagram and Pinterest, the challenge for e-retailers is to inspire Internet users. To do this, he must stage his products and offer beautiful images that attract attention and encourage you to click. Beyond that, I can of course cite the 3D visuals which are a great innovation. They allow you to clearly understand the details and quality of a product. However, this is still reserved for a certain category of e-retailers.

What impact do quality visuals have on an e-commerce site?

One of the determining criteria for the act of buying on the Internet remains the trust granted to the merchant. Behind an online store, the Internet user can have many fears related to delivery times, a size error... Offering quality visuals is a first step towards this relationship of trust. In the high-tech, home appliance, and IT industries, detailed images allow customers to understand the complex functionalities of products. In fact, with a HD visual of the product, the user will be able to see the details of the product and its quality. This will reassure him and, perhaps, convince him to buy. On the other hand, a non-qualitative image leaves a feeling of amateurism and it will be much more difficult to convert when your competitors do better than you.

Is it possible to reconcile the activity of electronic merchant and photographer?

Absolutely! And I would even add that you can sell online in parallel with any activity. By 2020, the turnover of online sales is estimated at 4 000 billion euros in the world. The good thing is that now everyone can get a piece of this pie.

With WiziShop, we have made online sales accessible to everyone; at 2 levels: technically, it is now very easy to create an online store, even without any technical skills. At WiziShop, we take care of all the technical part, the hosting... The merchant thus focuses on the essentials: the sale of its products. The other level is the financial aspect. The creation of an online store now costs only a few euros.

You offer dropshipping, what is it?

Thanks to Dropshipping, it is no longer even necessary to create a product or to have stock to sell online. Entrepreneurs have access to a catalog of thousands of products that they can choose to sell on their own online store without having stock. The e-merchant only acts as an intermediary between the supplier and the end customer. That is how, in the coming days, we will come up with a completely new solution, Dropizi.fr, which allows you to sell by dropshipping.

The idea is to create your own online store, choose the products you want to sell from thousands of references and then sell without worrying about logistics or product delivery. The advantage is that it makes for very nice salary supplements. And online sales are available to everyone: employees, self-employed, unemployed, students, retirees... And, if in addition, you are a good photographer, you have all the assets to highlight the products you sell (whether in a traditional way or by dropshipping) and thus ensure the success of your business.

What are the decisive factors in the mechanism of the online purchase decision?

There are a lot of them and it would be an impossible mission to rank them in order of importance. In bulk, I would therefore quote:

  • La quality of the offer
  • Les tariffs
  • La quality of services (shipping costs, payment facilities, delivery, returns...)
  • THEergonomics of the site
  • Les reinsurance elements
  • La description of the products
  • THEbranding (impacted by the quality of the visuals)...
  • Les Dealer reviews
  • La customer service responsiveness

What are the advantages of producing visuals in-house for an e-merchant?

Quite naturally, the production of visuals in-house allows Time saver, a Control of the budget And a great reactivity if necessary. Not depending on an external service provider is a considerable advantage. You still need to have the skills in-house...

Finally, what would you advise a beginner e-merchant to produce their own visuals?

A beginning e-merchant should STraining at all levels. There are a number of resources on the Web to learn on your own, discover and master the challenges of selling online. For the creation of visuals, it's the same. Get trained in photography, learn how to set up and use your camera and how to retouch your photos afterwards. In the field of skincare and cosmetics, mastering photography makes it possible to capture the nuances of products and highlight their effectiveness.

PackshotCreator is an excellent partner to undertake this process. Invest in a nice camera and a mini photo studio right from the start. These are investments that will give you real independence, total freedom and that will pay off in the medium term. Finally, for your product sheets, choose two types of visuals:

  1. The first is to present your product on white background so that the user can fully understand its details
  2. The second type of visual consists in putting your product put in a situation (a piece of clothing on a model or a sofa in his living room, for example...) so that the Internet user can project himself

Conclusion

In conclusion, the production of visuals in-house is a key element for success in e-commerce. Explore PackshotCreator solutions to improve your visual strategy and strengthen your online presence.

faqs.question: How does the quality of visuals influence customer trust in e-commerce?
faqs.answer: High-quality visuals are the first point of contact between the customer and your products. They convey a sense of professionalism and reduce the uncertainty associated with buying online. Detailed and HD images allow customers to better understand product features, increasing their trust and significantly improving conversion rates.

faqs.question: What are the economic advantages of producing visuals in-house rather than using an external service provider?
faqs.answer: In-house production offers three major economic advantages: considerable time savings by eliminating going back and forth with service providers, total control of the budget without recurring costs, and great responsiveness allowing you to quickly adapt your visuals to new trends or seasonal promotions.

faqs.question: How do you choose between a standard photo studio and an automated solution like Orbitvu?
faqs.answer: This choice depends on your production volume and your visual coherence needs. An automated solution like Orbitvu becomes profitable as soon as you regularly photograph more than 20 products per month and look for consistency in your visuals. It allows you to obtain consistent professional results, even without special photography skills.

faqs.question: What types of visuals are the most effective for increasing e-commerce sales?
faqs.answer: Studies show that a combination of two types of visuals is particularly effective: photos on a white background to highlight the details and characteristics of the product, and scenario photos that allow the customer to project himself into the use of the product. 360° animations also increase conversion rates by an average of 30%.

faqs.question: How does artificial intelligence improve the production of e-commerce visuals?
faqs.answer: The AI integrated into modern solutions like Orbitvu automates the calibration of lighting, optimizes shooting parameters according to the type of product, and facilitates post-processing (automatic clipping, color adjustment). This makes it possible to obtain professional results even without technical expertise, while reducing production time by 80%.
